name: IPS Conservation Grants
summary: Small grants for primate conservation field programmes and applied research with conservation impact, with an extra award for community conservation components. Basic research or education-only proposals are excluded.

amount.note: Plus an additional $500 community conservation award possible

amount.quote: soliciting applications of up to $1,500 to support the development of primate conservation field programs and/or applied research with impact on primate conservation. If you plan to include community conservation in your program, you may be eligible for an additional Conservation through Community Involvement (CCI) award of $500.
